title: must need may might
rule: must (law) vs need to (admin) vs may/might (permission) — not “legally required to.” Don’t use can/could for permission (those mean ability).
pass_when: Legal obligation = must; admin = need to; permission = may/might.
fail_when: “Legally required to”; can/could used for permission.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
